summary: A short biographical note on Jeryl Sasser, a basketball player born in Dallas, Texas. It covers his high school and college background at Southern Methodist University, his selection by the Orlando Magic in the 2001 NBA Draft, and his brief NBA career with the Magic.
one_line: Jeryl Sasser is a former basketball player from Dallas who was drafted 22nd overall by the Orlando Magic in 2001.
key_facts: Jeryl Sasser was born in Dallas, Texas.
Jeryl Sasser graduated from Justin F. Kimball High School.
Jeryl Sasser played college basketball at Southern Methodist University.
The Orlando Magic selected Jeryl Sasser as the 22nd pick in the 2001 NBA Draft.
Jeryl Sasser played two seasons for the Orlando Magic.
The two seasons with the Orlando Magic were Jeryl Sasser's only seasons in the NBA.
Jeryl Sasser averaged 2.5 points per game in the NBA.
